Within the crossed block, the adjective after est is read triviale rather than C’s fidèle; this is an ink decision and no proof is inferred from the cancelled paragraph. The bottom Hodge label has a π form, while the last subspace label is H. The lower diagram connectors have no written endpoint objects; the transcription retains their blank endpoints. Archive number 162. No mathematical claim in this heavily revised block was independently checked.
